items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: It’s like when Maynard started he had Joe Glaser from ABC Booking... And the way Maynard got started was that Joe would call these people

ctx.x: And she helps me when she can but it’s very difficult. I think you really need a high powered booking agent. It’s like when Maynard started he had Joe Glaser from ABC Booking and the way Maynard got started was that Joe would call these people and say, “you want Miles in there for a couple of weeks?” And they’d say, “yeah, I’d love to have him.” “Well how about Maynard Ferguson?” “No, never heard of him.” And Joe would say, “if you want Miles, you’ll take Maynard too.” And they got him. Of course Joe and a lot of…
Well it’s been a pleasure talking with you.
